rationale: Retain one active American Natural record, but correct its perimeter to the American Natural Supply fuel-terminal, storage and distribution-logistics business retained by Cleopatra Resources LLC after the December 2023 sale of substantially all retail assets to Giant Oil. Tiger Infrastructure Partners' May 2015 investment and current involvement are evidenced, but the exact fund, acquisition vehicle, security, ownership percentage and current co-investors are not publicly disclosed; remove the unsupported Fund I attribution rather than infer those facts.

beforeImage.name: American Natural
beforeImage.subsector: Multi-fuel retail and wholesale fuel distribution
beforeImage.description: American Natural owns and operates multi-fuel retail fueling stations and wholesale fuel distribution operations in western Pennsylvania and eastern Ohio. Its customer base includes commercial fleets, retail motorists, and wholesale fuel users seeking conventional and alternative-fuel supply. The operating model is asset-heavy and based on station, logistics, and fuel-distribution infrastructure. Public materials describe the company as Pittsburgh-based and focused on natural gas, other alternative fuels, and conventional fuel supply. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund I closed its initial investment in American Natural's parent platform in 2015 and is the current sponsor identified in public portfolio materials.

afterImage.name: American Natural
afterImage.subsector: Fuel terminals, storage and distribution logistics
afterImage.description: American Natural is the Tiger-backed fuel-infrastructure platform held through Cleopatra Resources LLC and now centered on American Natural Supply. The retained business provides commercial fuel supply, storage, terminal, delivery and logistics services to commercial, industrial and Marcellus/Utica customers. Tiger closed its investment in May 2015, but the exact fund, vehicle, security and ownership percentage are not publicly disclosed. American Natural Supply acquired key Satterlee assets in 2017, and Cleopatra sold substantially all American Natural Retail PA assets to Giant Oil in December 2023; those divested retail locations are outside the retained platform perimeter.
